invariants.rationale: The method constructs and always returns a HoodieWriteMetadata object; it never returns null.
inputRecords is dereferenced and used in the method; method cannot execute if null.
If there are no input records, then the returned WriteStatuses list should be empty.
WriteStatuses are accumulated into a LinkedList and set in the result; this reference should never be null.
The number of WriteStatuses cannot exceed the number of input records processed.
